items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: I know he had those instruments and I saw him play them.

ctx.x: Yeah, he said they'd walk around with maybe a guitar, a banjo and a violin, something like that, you see.
And about Joe Clancy, how many instruments did he play?
That I know of, bass, trombone and drums. Now if there were any others I don't know. I know he had those instruments and I saw him play them.
